_source: In-game Affection heart reference (FOMT Animal Affection).
_note: Converts an animal's raw Affection Points memory value (see data/pointer_map.md's 'Animal (Coop/Barn) struct' section, +0x188, u32) into its displayed heart count (0-10). Same ascending-minimum lookup convention as friendship_notes.json: find the tier with the LARGEST 'min_affection' that is <= the value. Conditions/Byproduct columns from the source reference are intentionally omitted -- not needed for the heart-count lookup.
